_comment: Kayo Specialization. Roll a 6 sided die, gain action points equal to half the number rolled (rounded down). If you've rolled a 6 on a die this turn, draw a card. ROLL records DIE_ROLLED_SIX turn-scoped, so the draw sees earlier rolls this turn too.

on_success._comment: action points are an asset, not a combat keyword

effects._comment: resolves now, not at end of turn
